rules.shared_phase: Both grains use the common C15 face center as an FCC lattice-site anchor.
rules.fixed_geometry: All candidates use size=9.25, the same equal-volume C15 Laguerre cells, and the same overlap cutoff. Size-series screening is disabled.
rules.single_layer: For each site-class face-normal direction, only one spatial CSL layer is retained. Four grains from the duplicate Z12 layers remain ordinary independently oriented grains.
rules.ordinary_grains: Grains 11, 12, 15, and 16 use the same seeded random orientations in every candidate, retain their own center anchors, and remain at least 1 degree away from Sigma3/Sigma5 angles relative to every other grain.
